name: Nightmare, the Fallen Moon

effects.name: Enhancement Bonus
effects.tooltip: +7 Enhancement Bonus : +7 enhancement bonus to attack and damage rolls .

effects.name: Keen
effects.tooltip: Keen : Passive: The base critical threat range of this weapon is doubled. This does not stack with Improved Critical feat. Vorpal Strikes by this weapon also bypass all Fortification .

effects.name: Entropic
effects.tooltip: Entropic : An entropic weapon crackles with a sinister energy that seeks to unmake anything it contacts. When it strikes a target, they take an extra 2 to 12 points of untyped damage.

effects.name: Life Stealing
effects.tooltip: Life Stealing : This weapon has a chance to drain 1 to 3 levels from its target on a critical hit.

effects.name: Vampirism
effects.tooltip: Vampirism : This weapon drains a tiny portion of the target's life force whenever it does damage. Note: provides 1d3 hp of healing per hit.

effects.name: Nightmares
effects.tooltip: Nightmares : This weapon terrorizes your foes, applying a Mind Thrust effect on successful hits (dealing 5 to 40 force damage, Will vs. Enchantments negates) and exposing your foes to their greatest fears on vorpal hits , acting as a Phantasmal Killer spell.

children: Attuned by Heroism: Tier 1 Adds Planar Conflux
Attuned by Heroism: Tier 2 +7 Enhancement Bonus → +8 Enhancement Bonus
Attuned by Heroism: Tier 3 Adds +0.5 weapon dice multiplier
Attuned by Heroism: Tier 4 Adds Red Augment Slot

flavor_text: A moonblade is an elven artifact, passed down a family lineage from parent to child. Only a worthy heir to their house is able to wield a moonblade. This blade, however, has fallen far from its origin. Having been corrupted by dark magic, Nightmare will serve anyone strong enough to claim it... for a time.

source.raw: Caught in the Web , End Chest
